title: TILDE: Teacher-in-the-Loop Distillation from Embodied Foundation Models
why: Teacher-harness distillation for embodied manipulation: frozen finetuned π0.5 teacher + AutoDAgger (Robometer task monitor + execution manager) detects student failure, triggers teacher recovery, and aggregates student-rollout states with recovery trajectories for on-policy action-space distillation into a student without action pretraining. Instantiates success/progress monitoring and first-error teacher correction for real-robot VLA transfer.
mechanism: AutoDAgger loop: off-the-shelf Robometer reward model as task monitor (progress p_t + success prob q_t); execution manager detects progress stagnation (T_fail) and hands control from student to frozen π0.5 teacher for recovery; retains student pre-intervention + successful teacher recovery. Distillation objective mixes BC+KD on demos/recoveries and KD-only on student-visited states (architecture-agnostic action-space targets).
evaluation_signal: Author-reported real-world AgileX PiperX 7-DoF on Fold Dishcloth / Pick Pen / Pick Beverage (12/27/30 fixed trials): TILDE scores 63.9 / 80.6 / 69.2 ≈ 3.07× / 2.18× / 4.14× BC; recovery SR 8/12 vs BC 4/12 on 12 Fold Dishcloth error states; AutoDAgger recovery-time ~2.2–2.6× faster than HG-DAgger (Table 4). Also LIBERO / LIBERO-Plus sim + cross-architecture distillation (appendix). §4.1–4.3.
